title: Load status state machine
description: Implement the load status state machine as pure data structures and pure functions. Defines the complete transition map (13 statuses), prerequisites, warnings, and side effect tags. Provides a validateTransition function that checks allowed transitions, admin-only rules, notes requirements, and prerequisites. TDD approach: write comprehensive tests first covering all valid and invalid transitions. See TDD §5 for implementation reference and PRD §5 for the full state machine spec. File: hussle-app-dispatch-api/src/shared/stateMachine.ts.
acceptanceCriteria: TRANSITIONS map covers all 13 statuses with correct allowed targets per PRD §5
validateTransition(fromStatus, toStatus, context) returns { valid, error?, warnings? }
Context includes { userRole, load, notes? } for prerequisite and permission checks
QUOTED → BOOKED requires carrierId on the load (returns error if missing)
BOOKED → DISPATCHED requires driverId AND vehicleId on the load
EXCEPTION and PAID transitions restricted to ADMIN role only
EXCEPTION and CANCELED transitions require notes (returns error if empty/missing)
DISPATCHED transition warns if rateConReceivedAt is null ('No broker rate con on file')
DELIVERED transition warns if bolSignedAt is null ('No signed BOL on file')
TRANSITION_SIDE_EFFECTS exported: BOOKED→CALCULATE_FINANCIALS, DISPATCHED→FREEZE_FINANCIALS, DELIVERED→AUTO_GENERATE_INVOICE, TONU→[AUTO_CREATE_TONU_ACCESSORIAL, AUTO_GENERATE_INVOICE]
KANBAN_GROUPS exported matching PRD exactly (6 groups with colors and status arrays)
Invalid transitions return descriptive error: 'Cannot transition from [X] to [Y]. Allowed: [list]'
PAID and CANCELED are terminal — no transitions allowed from them (per cross-feature decision L-003)
All test cases pass before implementation code is written (TDD RED phase)
validationCommand: cd hussle-app-dispatch-api && npx jest --coverage src/shared/stateMachine && npx tsc --noEmit
